title: Character Generator Pricing | southparkmaker
h1: A little credit. A lot of character.
text:
A little credit. A lot of character.

Keep the manual builder free. Add credits for AI characters when you need them, with a one-time pack or a monthly allowance.

Credit purchases are not available yet. You can explore the plans below and use the free character builder with PNG and SVG downloads.

1K and 1.5K images use 15 credits each. 2K images use 26 credits each. Each request creates one image. Your chosen resolution determines the cost shown before generation.

100 credits = $1 in every plan. The manual character builder and its PNG/SVG exports remain free.
